description: Use when the user asks what is known about the ground around a point in Western Australia: who holds it, what has been mined, found or drilled nearby, and what limits access. Returns a compact summary within `radius_km` of: tenure (whether the point is under a live tenement and its holder, from the public tenement register), nearby mines (MINEDEX) and known deposits, open-file drillholes, company drillhole and surface geochemistry (maximum Au and the highest-grade downhole intercept), GSWA regional geochemistry, WAMEX reports (each with an anumber, which wamex_report_files or document_files turn into files), the nearest mapped fault and magnetic and gravity worms, past exploration activity, host geology and regolith, land access (conservation reserves, native title, ILUAs, pastoral leases) and indicative Aboriginal heritage, plus a mapUrl. Pass `sections` to get those sections in full detail.

metal.description: Optional; filters known deposits to this commodity (Au, Cu, Ni, W, Sn, Co, Ta, Mn, REE)

sections.description: Sections to return in full detail; omit for the compact summary only. geochem = company drillhole/surface + GSWA assay anomalies; geology = host bedrock + regolith cover; landaccess = conservation reserves, native title, Indigenous Land Use Agreements (ILUAs) & pastoral leases; heritage = indicative Aboriginal heritage (not a clearance).

name: inspect_point
title: Inspect a point
